name_input: ESSEL PROPACK LTD.; EPL LIMITED; ESSEL PROPACK LIMITED
actual_hs_list: 39239090 (laminated tubes / extruded tubes — plastic tube containers, other articles of plastics for conveyance/packing)
39201019 / 39201099 (plastic laminate web/sheet, non-cellular, of polymers of ethylene — semi-finished laminate stock)
76072090 (aluminium-foil based ABL laminate web, if classified as foil-backed laminate)
product_summary: EPL Limited (ex-Essel Propack) is a specialty packaging converter, not a petrochemical/chemical producer. Real product lines per own website (eplglobal.com): (1) Laminates — ABL (aluminium barrier laminate) and PBL (plastic barrier laminate) web stock, LLDPE-based multi-layer structures with Al foil or EVOH barrier, 5-layer structures, custom/metallic/holographic/soft-touch laminates (source: eplglobal.com/products/laminates/); (2) Laminated Tubes — ABL/PBL tubes for oral care (~70% of laminated tube output), cosmetics, pharma/OTC, food, industrial (source: eplglobal.com/products/laminated-tubes/); (3) Extruded Tubes — seamless monolayer (LLDPE/LDPE/MDPE/HDPE) and co-extruded 2/5-layer sleeves, incl. Arista Tubes (UK) line (source: eplglobal.com/products/extruded-tubes/); (4) Caps & Closures — injection-moulded closures, snap-on, orientation, tamper-evident bands (source: eplglobal.com/products/caps-and-closures/); (5) Dispensing Systems / applicators, tube nozzles. End-use industries: Oral Care, Beauty & Cosmetics, Pharma & Health, Food & Nutrition, Home Care.
comment: HS 392010 ('plates, sheets, film, foil and strip, non-cellular, of polymers of ethylene, not reinforced') is only PARTIALLY correct: it fits the laminate web stock (LLDPE/PE-based ABL/PBL laminate in rolls) that EPL produces and sells as semi-finished material, so the code is retained and not a rejection ground (Rule 3). However the declared code does not cover the company's main revenue lines: finished laminated and extruded TUBES are plastic containers/ packing articles and belong in 3923 (typically 3923 90 90; tube-specific subheadings under 3923), caps & closures in 3923 50, dispensing systems/applicators in 3926 90. Aluminium-barrier laminate web with foil may also be argued under 7607 20 90 depending on whether the Al foil or the plastic predominates — cannot be resolved without customs line data. Industry misclassification: 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — EPL is a specialty packaging converter (plastics converting / FMCG packaging), no oil & gas or bulk chemical products on the site. Trader signs: none — own manufacturing plants (e.g. Vapi, Nalagarh units cited in own award news), in-house R&D, injection moulding and printing; role = manufacturer. Product lines missing from the declaration: laminated tubes, extruded tubes, caps & closures, dispensing systems/applicators, and printed/decorated tube assemblies. All product identifications above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs/B-L line was available to me in this task (customs volumes and shipment records were out of scope per instructions), so no HS line is corroborated by an actual shipment record. No registry, revenue or volume data researched.
